description: Specify CFD ball group names. Use of the group logic is described in Groups. By default, s is assigned to the group slot Default. Use the remove keyword to remove s from all slots.

keywords.name: slot
keywords.description: Set group slot slot to s. By default, slot Default is used.

examples.description: Assign the group in the Default slot

notes: On 7.00 and 9.8 the command is accepted and echoes the assignment, but it is not retrievable afterwards: ball.cfd.group reads 'None' and isgroup False. On 6.00 the assignment persists.

The manuals list an 'add' keyword (assign s to the next available slot). The engine rejects it with 'Unused extra parameter' on 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8, after it has already assigned s to slot Default. Use 'slot <s2>' to pick another slot.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (state grade): on 6.00 ball.cfd.group reads back 'Default=<name>'; on 7.00 and 9.8 the command is accepted but the assignment is lost - treat it as unreliable there.
